chunks: Tell them: "If you think you alone will abide with God to the exclusion of the rest of Mankind, in the mansions of the world to come, then wish for death if what you say is true."

key_terms.الدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ: the Hereafter / the abode of the next world

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'wish for death' in Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a critique of the claim of exclusive divine favor, highlighting the tension between worldly attachment and the reality of the Hereafter. The challenge to 'wish for death' serves as a logical test of sincerity, revealing that their reluctance stems from awareness of their own sins rather than genuine confidence in their status. This narrative underscores the Shia emphasis on balancing hope in God's mercy with the fear of His justice, rejecting complacency in religious identity.
